human_objective.quote: 小额频繁交易提升胜率 + 大额收益率，让收益率胜率都很高冲击带单排行榜，自主策略完成
human_objective.venue_assumption: Binance USDT perpetual for existing data/execution; destination venue and ranking category not confirmed

leaderboard_scope_limits: No current rank/percentile asserted without same-time competitor distribution and exact destination venue/category
No estimated copierPnL without follower execution and minimum-order evidence
Historical no-deposit account uses initial capital as return denominator; real MaxBaseBalance requires deposit records
Winrate is net-profit-positive entire closed positions, not orders or partials

hypothesis.small: Completed hourly WilderRSI2<5 and close<mean5 while completed daily close>mean200; mirrorRSI2>95 and dailyclose<mean200 forshort. Only fresh edges.
hypothesis.core: Completed dailyRSI2<5 and close>mean200 long;mirror>95 belowmean200short. Signal only on23:00hourly bar so daily close is actually available at00:00entry.
hypothesis.exit: Hourly close above/below5hour mean or12hour cap. Daily close above/below5day mean or10day cap. Exits can realize losses; no profit-only exit filter.
hypothesis.risk: 2x,noDCA,no partials;small2slots/2percent margin/0.05percent capital initial risk;core3slots/10percent margin/0.25percent initial risk. Fixed2ATRstop, floor1percent/ceiling5percent hourly orfloor3percent/ceiling30percent daily. Include known fee in sizing. Native minimum orders can reject small risk budgets.
hypothesis.adaptation: RSI2/longtrend/shortmean recovery inspiration from public equity rules; this crypto-futures mirrored, risk-limited, intraday adaptation is new and unvalidated. No equity claimed return is transferred.

source_inspiration.role: Larry Connors2009author discussion of5period mean dynamic exit in stocks/ETFs; no claim of crypto profitability.

execution_schedule.goal_status: Combined must establish both sleeves positive and actual high net winrate/ROI; individual success is partial only.
